attributes.current:
3rd-level Champion feature

The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfabgZdk3v6tZF8-8x_description
attributes.current: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfabgds2VDJMi2UKiE_description
attributes.current:
You've studied your friends and foes alike and learned that victory relies on adaptability.

Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can gain proficiency in one skill from those available to the class at 1st level, as you remind yourself of past lessons. This proficiency lasts until the end of your next Long Rest.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfabgfXbdHmU6PkUbF_description
attributes.current:
7th-level Champion feature

The thrill of battle drives you towards victory.

Once per combat, you can give yourself advantage on one attack roll, ability check or saving throw. You must declare the advantage before the roll, and the feature is only used if the roll succeeds.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfabgj5Y-RfXxTXhv0_description
attributes.current:
7th-level Champion feature

You can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfah9epycBvWqRVE-K_description
attributes.current:
You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:

- You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. If you already have proficiency, you gain expertise instead.

- When you are prone, you can stand up without using any additional movement.

- Your movement speed cannot be reduced by non-magical means, including non-magical difficult terrain

- You gain a climbing and a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

- You can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfawr5IdJipMsspDZq_description
attributes.current:
A drive for perfection may be futile, but not fruitless. The precision you act with grants you an advantage over your opponents:

- Your critical hit range increases by 1 for attack rolls. Apply this after any features that may improve your critical hit range.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfaxGH9I48ljmD2FMl_description
attributes.current:
Your unique training method gives you accuracy only matched by the greatest of elves. You have uncanny aim with attacks that rely on precision rather than brute force. You gain the following benefits:

- Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcOOZN-CyG97EDc7i_description
attributes.current: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcRqLm9ifYrop2Vzi_description
attributes.current: While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv4kgWKw6NKzHTn0_description
attributes.current: Dwarves mature at the same rate as humans, but they're considered young until they reach the age of 50. On average, they live about 350 years.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv4oAvMLJ8RAeiGX_description
attributes.current: Dwarves stand between 4 and 5 feet tall and average about 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv4rRwFzFzRakUro_description
attributes.current: Your speed is not reduced by wearing heavy armor.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv4u0pnRrCHmZmg7_description
attributes.current: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv4xmIWh05fS-olW_description
attributes.current: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv5-fRddzJqmRzb2_description
attributes.current: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv52IfLPWVt5uAED_description
attributes.current: You gain proficiency with the artisan's tools of your choice: Smith's tools, brewer's supplies, or mason's tools.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv55JDr31R-fNLqk_description
attributes.current: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the origin of stonework, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv570nnQB0ODPL7W_description
attributes.current: You can speak, read, and write Common and Dwarvish. Dwarvish is full of hard consonants and guttural sounds, and those characteristics spill over into whatever other language a dwarf might speak.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfcv5BUx-wSApwh7II_description
attributes.current: You have proficiency with light and medium armor.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-OIfjGq5LYczB9SZDaL2_description
attributes.current:
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Puncture. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one of the attack's damage dice, and you must use the new roll.

Enhanced Critical. When you score a Critical Hit that deals Piercing damage to a creature, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the extra Piercing damage the target takes.
